searched_dims.note: added_dims in greedy selection order; dim_set in REPAIR_DIMS order. cost_class is the costliest class among the added dims.

nested_fixed.rule: for split s, a dimension is kept if the certificate's search selected it on more than half of the other four paper splits (3 or 4 of 4), the rule repair.adopt uses; mag is always kept. Scored like the fixed configuration: resolver for the load-torque group only, fitted on the group's fit-half cycles of split s.
nested_fixed.caveat: the other four splits' fit halves share settings with split s's test half, so the vote is not fully independent of split s

definitions.routed: held-out cycle whose rank-1 mode (declaration order) is in the load-torque group
definitions.member_frac: routed cycles whose true category is in the group / routed
definitions.route_acc: routed cycles the resolver labels correctly / routed
definitions.resolver_acc_members: correct / routed cycles that are true group members
definitions.member_recall: routed true members / true members in the test half

group_pairs_fixed.definition: pairwise accuracy for modes (a, b): among held-out group cycles whose true mode is a or b AND whose predicted mode is a or b, the fraction predicted correctly. The 3-way resolver is used as is; cycles predicted as the third mode are counted in n_other_mode, not scored. 'balanced' is the mean of the two modes' recalls on the same cycles.
group_pairs_fixed.definition_binary: pairs_binary: a separate two-class resolver (same dims) fitted on the pair's fit-half cycles and scored on all of the pair's held-out cycles
group_pairs_fixed.definition_restricted: pairs_restricted: all held-out cycles whose true mode is a or b, the 3-way resolver choosing between a and b only (argmax of its probabilities over the two). Unlike pair_acc it does not drop the cycles the resolver sends to the third mode, so it is the figure to quote.

dim_subsets.ranking: by mean within-group held-out accuracy over seeds 0-4, descending; ties broken by fewer dims, then name

definitions.tied: more than one mode within baselines.TIE_EPS of the rank-1 score
definitions.declaration: ties broken by FMEA declaration order, as retrieve() does
definitions.tie_aware: a cycle scores (true modes in the tied set) / (tied set size)

definitions.control_minus_targeted: per split, control minus targeted two-stage; sd is the sample sd (ddof=1); control_wins counts splits where the control is higher
definitions.labels_drawn: labels the arm spends in testable twin groups (targeted: up to k per group, summed over groups)
definitions.labels_fitted: labels in groups whose resolver was fitted (two classes present)
definitions.labels_applied: labels in resolvers that receive at least one held-out cycle; no cycle is ever routed to the collision or gripping group, so only load-torque labels can change a prediction and this count never exceeds k
definitions.paper_splits_mean: the same means over seeds 0-4 only
definitions.group_acc: the predicted mode's twin cluster equals the true one
